reason: A DeepSeek Harness web UI plugin focused on reclaiming content space through compact, right-sidebar, and collapsible sidebar layouts with persisted interface state.

summaries.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness Web 界面提供紧凑模式、右侧边栏和可折叠窄条布局，以减少界面占用并显示会话相关信息。
summaries.en: Provides compact, right-sidebar, and collapsible rail layouts for the DeepSeek Harness web interface to reduce chrome and preserve space for conversation content.

capabilities: Modifies the DeepSeek Harness web interface layout
Provides compact, right-sidebar, and collapsible sidebar modes
Persists layout state in browser localStorage
